_doc: Phrases tools/access-lab-claims.test.mjs would flag that are NOT claims the product makes about itself. Each needs a reason of 40+ characters; an entry that stops matching fails the test, so this file cannot collect stale absolutions. A real product claim is fixed in the copy, or backed by a verified row in docs/language-page/claims-ledger.md.

allowed.reason: Sample feedback line inside the Conversation Simulator praising a learner's definition; it describes the learner's answer, not the product.

Title and disclaimer of the BCPSS Efficacy Brief, a draft that states it makes no outcome, growth or causal claim and describes only curriculum coverage and software verification; the word names the document, it is not a claim about the product. Allowed at Joel's direction 2026-11-25.
